item.title: Stem Cells Repair Stroke Damage in Mice
item.description: Stem cell transplants regenerated stroke-damaged brain tissue in mice, creating new neurons and restoring motor function.

item.title: Brain Scans Suggest Cause of Long COVID Fatigue
item.description: Researchers found evidence that long COVID may damage dopamine-releasing neurons, potentially explaining persistent fatigue and brain fog.
